BEFORE YOU TURN ON THE CAMERA

Can this browser run webcam mode?

Check the setup for Skim's camera experiment. Your webcam stays off throughout this check.

CAMERA STAYS OFF

Start with a setup check.

After you click, this page loads the approximately 19 MB tracking library and its supporting files from this site, then tries starting them. Files already in your browser's cache may load faster. The check can take up to 45 seconds.

The result stays on this page. Nothing is sent as a diagnostic report, and this check does not ask for camera permission.

No check has been run.

Continue to the webcam lab ↗

The lab opens with the camera off. Choose Webcam gaze there when you are ready.

What a passing check means

Your browser started the tracking software. You will still need to choose camera access, calibrate, and pass the lab's separate accuracy check. This result does not establish how accurately Skim can follow your eyes on your device.

Camera access, lighting, head movement, and your browser's settings can affect the next step. Read the privacy details before trying the experiment.

Your pointer is ready to try.

The reading lab and extension work with your pointer. Move over a paragraph, choose what matters, and keep the original words in view.
